subject: Logic
title: Updating Beliefs Step by Step
description: A micro-lesson that makes Updating Beliefs Step by Step usable.

hook.text: One piece of evidence barely moves the needle. Stack ten and your belief transforms completely.

buildup.text: Bayesian updating is iterative. Each new posterior becomes the prior for the next piece of evidence.

discovery.text: A doctor runs test after test. Each result updates the diagnosis probability—narrowing the possibilities.

twist.text: Order doesn't matter mathematically. The same evidence in any sequence gives the same final posterior.

climax.text: Incremental updating prevents overreaction to single data points and builds confidence gradually.

quiz.question: In Bayesian updating, what does each posterior become?
options: The prior for the next update
